snippet.title: Longplay of Sonic the Hedgehog 3
snippet.description:
Longplay of Sonic the Hedgehog 3, played as the NTSC version on the Sega Genesis. This game's version was released on Feb. 2nd, 1994. Tell us what you think by leaving a comment down below!
